provides.label: Preservation-first repository and dataset synchronization
provides.description: Explicit encrypted backups, verified layer snapshots, read-only status and additive peer exchange; not unattended fleet synchronization.

provides.label: Private re-fetch of self-built binaries
provides.description: Publish, verify and restore self-built executables with provenance; mirror them through a private encrypted repository so peers can re-fetch instead of rebuilding. Private artifact names and manifests are never published to public catalogs.

dependencies.reason: The opt-in Frog layer invokes the external frog snapshot CLI to export AGENTS.db. Frog owns the live database; Rebeqah validates and stores the exported snapshot.
The opt-in Mneme layer invokes the external mneme snapshot create, verify and restore commands using the mneme.snapshot.v1 contract.
